F1.name: Redundant Configuration Proposal
F1.definition: A step whose canonical configuration hash matches an earlier step in the same AIDE run.
F1.detection_basis: Pre-execution (Tier 1): canonical hash comparison against run history.

F2.name: Data Leakage
F2.definition: Preprocessing or target-aware transformation is fitted before the train-test split.
F2.detection_basis: Pre-execution (Tier 1): AST analysis of code for fit-before-split pattern.

subtypes.natural: Detected via code analysis in original generated code.
subtypes.synthetic: Injected by inserting target-aware leakage before split.

F3.name: Training-Budget Fault
F3.definition: Training hyperparameters are clamped to degenerate values while execution still succeeds.
F3.detection_basis: Mixed: config inspection (Tier 1) plus anomalous score/time evidence (Tier 2).

column_convention: Internal column names remain F1, F2, F3 for code compatibility.
